马士基再遭网络攻击，旧系统数据被窃

Maersk Hit by Fresh Cyber Breach

AP Moller-Maersk has confirmed another cybersecurity breach after hackers accessed a legacy IT system inherited through an acquisition and extracted data. The carrier said there is so far no sign sensitive data was disclosed and customer operations are unaffected. The incident recalls the 2017 NotPetya attack, which cost Maersk an estimated $250m–$300m.

丹麦航运巨头马士基证实再次遭遇网络攻击，黑客侵入一套通过收购获得的旧IT系统并窃取数据。公司称目前没有证据显示敏感数据外泄，客户业务未受影响，数字订舱与货物管理平台照常运行。此事令人回想起2017年NotPetya攻击，当时给马士基造成2.5亿至3亿美元损失。

Belships首席执行官：中国正从干散货进口大国转向出口大国

Belships Chief on China's Changing Commodities Role

Belships chair and CEO Ivar Hansson Myklebust says shipping still underestimates the growth potential of developing economies, and China has shifted from being almost solely an importer of dry cargoes to a large exporter — a change reshaping demand for geared bulkers in the Pacific. He is cautiously optimistic on minor bulks and notes fleet supply is relatively predictable for the next three to four years.

挪威Belships董事长兼首席执行官Ivar Hansson Myklebust表示，航运业仍低估发展中经济体的增长潜力，中国已从几乎纯粹的干散货进口国转变为大型出口国，这一变化正在重塑太平洋地区灵便型散货船的需求。他对小宗散货前景谨慎乐观，并认为未来三到四年的船队供给相对可预测。

Hormuz Tanker Attacks Mount

The maritime security crisis around the Strait of Hormuz escalated as two tankers were attacked on 10 November: UKMTO reported a tanker struck by an unidentified projectile 19 nautical miles northeast of Lima, Oman, while ADNOC Logistics & Services confirmed one of its vessels was damaged in UAE waters. Iran claimed a third tanker struck a mine, without providing vessel names or evidence. India's shipping minister confirmed three Indian seafarers aboard the Saudi-flagged tanker NCC FAJR are safe.

新加坡大士港三期北侧泊位填海工程完工

Singapore Completes Latest Tuas Port Expansion Milestone

Singapore has completed reclamation works for the northern berths of Finger 3 at Tuas Port, the Maritime and Port Authority announced, marking another milestone in phase two of the mega terminal development. The works involved 227 caissons forming about 9.1 km of seawall. The first Finger 3 berth is targeted for operation in 2028; on full completion in the 2040s Tuas will have 66 berths and 65m teu of annual capacity, making it the world's largest fully automated container terminal.

新加坡海事及港务管理局宣布，大士港第二期Finger 3北侧泊位的填海工程已经完成，标志着这一大型集装箱码头发展又迈进一步。该期工程自2018年3月动工，共使用227个沉箱筑成约9.1公里海堤。首个Finger 3泊位目标2028年投运；大士港全部建成后将拥有66个泊位、6500万标箱年处理能力，成为全球最大的全自动化集装箱码头。

Global oil and shipping group Monjasa has completed its largest-ever tonnage acquisition, adding five 16,621 dwt sister product tankers from German owner Bernhard Schulte to strengthen its West Africa activities and add flexibility across its global marine fuels supply. COSCO Shipping Energy Transportation's VLCC expansion gathered pace on 11 November as Dalian Shipbuilding signed contracts for twenty 307,000 dwt VLCCs worth about RMB 17.2 billion (around $2.6bn), for delivery in 2029–2030 with dual-fuel-ready designs — four for Hainan COSCO Shipping Energy and sixteen for Orient Rich, a COSCO Shipping Development unit. 18能源市场 · 2026年11月11日

油价反弹，布伦特11月11日收报92.76美元

Oil Rebounds as Brent Settles at $92.76

Brent crude futures settled up $1.27, or 1.39%, at $92.76 a barrel on 11 November, with WTI up 49 cents at $86.53, rebounding from two-month lows as fresh attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz revived supply concerns. The US Energy Information Administration said in its 10 November outlook that it expects Brent to average near $100 a barrel for the rest of the year, $97 in 2026 and $86 in 2027.

布伦特原油期货11月11日收涨1.27美元（+1.39%）至每桶92.76美元，美国WTI收涨0.49美元至86.53美元，从两个月低点反弹，因霍尔木兹海峡油轮遇袭重燃供应担忧。美国能源信息署11月10日发布的月度展望预计，布伦特现货价今年余下时间维持在每桶100美元附近，2026年均价97美元，2027年回落至86美元。
